Plate 1 view (cobalt key), Plate 2 view (vermilion accent)
Hold Separate: the two plates lift apart
Drag plate 2 across the sheet (to 6.00 / 6.00 mm), then Register plate 2 exactly
Loupe at 2:1 swept over the sun (export pixels)

capture_method: Playwright 1.64 Chromium headless, CDP Page.startScreencast (JPEG q90), frames placed by metadata.timestamp, static frames capped at 0.8s, resampled to 30 fps CFR, libx264 CRF 26 preset veryslow, +faststart, -an
